subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the Centre.

D sits third to the left of F. G sits second to the left of D. G sits to the immediate right of E. B sits to the immediate left of A.

What is the position of D with respect to B?
solution: Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the Centre. 1) D sits third to the left of F. 2) G sits second to the left of D. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e7099d3b87c4d4cb279d4cf93411cbdca91931cab8308a9926a32337030d662.png]
